name: Vice Principal
source: The vice principal of Kohnodai Academy. As an overseer of the academy, he isn’t afraid of making decisions that are unpopular with students if it resolves a foreseeable problem. Although he has some measure of trust in the students, he is as strict as is needed to protect the academy.
